newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian police arrest Gypsies in drugs ring.
newsitem.headline: Italian police arrest Gypsies in drugs ring.

text.p: Italian police said on Friday they had smashed a drugs ring and arrested 30 Gypsies in a raid on their camp outside Florence.
"The main source of income for the camp had become drugs sales -- cocaine, methadone and above all heroin," Florence police chief Francesco Forleo told reporters.
He said the gang had used violence to force Gypsy children to sell an average of one kilogram (two lbs) of heroin every week, some of it entering Italy from former Yugoslavia.
Police, who confiscated only small quantities of drugs at the camp, said they were still looking for 12 other Gypsies suspected of being part of the ring.
The operation, which began last August after one of the camp's residents died of an overdose, relied on testimony from several Gypsy families, police said.
